member.name: M:FinderMod.Search.Options.Option.Execute(FinderMod.Search.XORShift128)
member.summary:
Execution, assuming an arbitrary given seed. Returns the distance of the calculated fields for the option from the values in the inputs.
Things to keep in mind for a good distance calculation:
All inputs that should affect the result should be accounted for.
Most common input types are accounted for with the built-in DistanceIf helper methods, which already account for most factors.
If an input does not have a DistanceIf implementation, it is up to you to replace its calculation. An ideal distance calculation should be between 0 and 1, then multiplied by the input's bias. If the input is disabled, it should contribute 0 distance.
member.param: The random number generator correlating with the seed. Use like .
